name: ai-usage-monitor
title: AI Usage Monitor
description: Watch Claude Code and Codex rate limits in one keyboard-first dashboard, and get notified before you hit one.
author: kedrzu

commands.name: show-usage
commands.title: Show AI Usage
commands.subtitle: Claude Code · Codex
commands.description: Show every AI limit at a glance: session, weekly and per-model windows.

commands.name: monitor
commands.title: Monitor AI Usage
commands.subtitle: Claude Code · Codex
commands.description: Check usage in the background and notify when a threshold is crossed.

preferences.name: notifyHUD
preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.label: Raycast HUD
preferences.description: Show a Raycast HUD when a threshold is crossed.

preferences.name: notifyNotificationCenter
preferences.label: macOS Notification Center
preferences.description: Post a macOS notification when a threshold is crossed.

preferences.name: sessionThresholds
preferences.title: Session Thresholds
preferences.description: Comma-separated percentages that trigger a session notification.

preferences.name: weeklyThresholds
preferences.title: Weekly Thresholds
preferences.description: Comma-separated percentages that trigger a weekly notification.

preferences.name: resetWarnings
preferences.title: Reset Warnings
preferences.description: Comma-separated minutes before a limit resets. Only fires while that window is actually in use. Leave empty to disable.
